academy-tower.alt: The tall spire of Selrick Academy rises above a plaza at sunset, a thin cyan beam of light climbing from its tip.

bay.alt: From high above at night, lit towers line the water of Terrinia's bay, with a ring-crowned tower and dark violet smoke over the city.

gold-giant.alt: The gold giant spreads its arms before the broken dome, a ring of light around it and a glow kindling in its chest.
The gold giant's glowing head fills an orange sunset sky while Fanny hangs tiny before it.

guineveres-red-bows.alt: Guinevere, her hair tied with red bows, points up at the fireworks while she holds Vexana's hand.

laylas-lab.alt: Layla at her cluttered lab desk among monitors, small drones, a gold trophy and a seedling under a glass dome.

mother-matrix.alt: The Mother Matrix spreads huge dark wings over a purple ruined city, two tiny figures standing far below it.
The Mother Matrix spreads across a purple sky, its dark armored head crowned with spikes and its claws held out.
A close view of the Mother Matrix's dark armored head, crowned with spikes, its eyes glowing purple.

obsidias-weapon.alt: Obsidia floats in the dark with her long weapon trailing from her hand, fiery blades at her back, while Selena hangs bound above.
Obsidia beside her weapon, a spiked beast helm with a long jointed chain behind it, gold blades floating around her.

research-base.alt: Lesley leans toward small Chang'e and Mr. Bunny in the bright lab of the research base, Chang'e's parents behind them.
Chang'e stands at a bench in the bright research base lab, with a glass case and rifle parts spread out before her.
Seen from behind, Chang'e climbs a steep blue stair in the research base.

seedling.alt: A small seedling grows under a glass dome on Layla's lab desk, beside a gold trophy and a hovering drone.

summer-fireworks.alt: Guinevere and Vexana hold hands under bursting fireworks, Guinevere pointing at the sky.
Guinevere and Vexana hold hands on a dark hill and look up at pink and gold fireworks.

third-year-classroom.alt: In the bright classroom Selena sleeps on her arms at her desk, dreaming of a cupcake, while Layla holds up a paper plane behind her.
Selena lifts her head from her desk in the classroom, with a glass screen on the desk and Layla waving from the back.

academys-lists.alt: A ranking board lists four chibi portraits by score, from 1800 down to 900, while chibi Layla watches among a crowd of silhouettes.

clawed-glove.alt: Obsidia floats in a black gown with one clawed black glove raised, her silver-pink weapon hanging in the air beside her.
Obsidia sits back with a clawed black glove stretched out, thin red threads hanging from its fingers.

hangar.alt: Armored Oro soldiers stand in a bright hangar, with a small pink-haired girl between two of them at the bottom edge.

throne-hall.alt: Wide dark stairs climb to a jointed column lit violet in the throne hall, a small figure waiting at its foot, seen past Selena's long hair.

landing-in-terrinia.alt: A ship flies over burning Terrinia at sunset while giant Enders stand among the towers.
Two Selrick students sit in the dust of a ruined street at sunset, seen past the reaching metal hands of an android.
An android fires a bolt of purple light before a giant Ender among the burning ruins of Terrinia.

protectors-of-all-humanity.alt: Layla raises her cannon to the night sky with a smile, and Fanny smiles beside her.

rubys-summons.alt: In a vast dark hall of pillars with violet windows, a small figure stands in a circle of light on the floor.
Ruby stands in profile looking away, beside her father in his dark fur-collared coat.
Ruby faces forward in the dark hall while her father walks out through a bright doorway far behind her.

seawall-raid.alt: Guinevere and Vexana stand back to back under a smoky gray sky, Guinevere's gloved fist raised and Vexana's violet eyes fixed ahead.

taking-of-vexana.alt: Vexana's tearful face sinks into a closing dark crack in the pale wall as she is dragged away.

vexanas-transformation.alt: After the change, a dark horn rises through Vexana's pale hair and violet star-shaped blades glow at her cloaked shoulder.

wills-vision.alt: Dusty gloved hands cup a small star badge that glows and sheds sparks.

boy-with-the-red-tie.alt: Ruby walks through the burning ruins with her scythe toward a boy in a Selrick uniform who stands in her way.

grass-behind-the-hall.alt: Fanny lies on her back in the sunny grass in her school uniform, her eyes shut.

helper-droid.alt: Design sheet of an Academy helper droid: a slim white machine with an orange eye, long jointed arms, a spare arm and a head drawn beside it.
